# augmented brain

> Your brain, augmented with AI. augmented brain gives an AI assistant (Claude Code today) memory, a method and a guard: it remembers your tasks, decisions and people from one session to the next, works through tasks with a method, and asks before touching anything risky. Everything is plain Markdown files of yours, backed up to your own git. Free, MIT, alpha; Linux, macOS and Windows.

Install with one command, which asks the language, offers to install what is missing (git, Claude Code, the Claude desktop app), creates two spaces (work and personal) in ~/augmented-brain and opens Claude:

    curl -fsSL https://github.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh

On Windows, in PowerShell:

    irm https://github.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex

The first session is a short guided interview. A local web panel (`augmented-brain panel`, or `/brain:panel` in Claude Code) shows today at a glance across every space and lets you see and edit tasks, reminders, the inbox, the weekly review, areas, knowledge, rules, people, the names of your secrets (never their values), sessions, the profile, health, the map of your git repositories (Repositories), the guard's lists (Guard), the configuration's last versions (Versions) and Help (links to these docs and a problem report for GitHub). A session outside every space's folder (such as a new session in the Claude desktop app with no folder chosen) uses the personal space.

On Linux, `augmented-brain remote install` keeps Claude on the computer reachable from claude.ai or Claude Desktop after a reboot, and `augmented-brain session start <task>` opens a remote session of its own for one task. `augmented-brain panel remote` opens the panel from a phone through the user's own Tailscale network. The configuration keeps its last 10 versions on the computer (`augmented-brain config history`, `config restore`).

The documentation, as web pages: https://icalvete.github.io/augmented-brain/guide/

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/getting-started.md): what it is; from nothing to the first session for people new to the terminal; what you need (a paid Claude plan), phrases for the first week, a glossary
- [Installing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/install.md): what the installer does on Linux, macOS and Windows, where it puts things, updating and uninstalling
- [Spaces](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/spaces.md): work and personal apart; the folder picks the space; the default space; adding a space; shared notes
- [Tasks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/tasks.md): the task file, the six phases, park and resume, the journal, steps and subtasks, watch dates, closing
- [Areas, knowledge and the rest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/notes.md): areas, references and lessons, people, the inbox, rules, the profile, repositories, the index
- [The guard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/guard.md): what it stops and what it asks; repository lists; merging pull requests; production profiles, untouchable hosts, root exceptions; a safety net, not a security boundary
- [How it works inside](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/how-it-works.md): the four layers, a session step by step, where every file lives, what it does not do
- [What Claude may do without asking you](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/what-claude-may-do.md): never, always asks, without asking; the guard and Claude Code's permissions together; the seal of the guard's lists
- [Where everything lives](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/where-things-live.md): notes, configuration, state and secrets' names: where, how each is protected, what the backup takes
- [What to say to Claude](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/phrases.md): phrases for tasks, the inbox, knowledge, rules, people, safety, backup and the panel
- [The panel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/panel.md): the local web panel and every page: Today, Tasks, Reminders, Inbox, Weekly review, Areas, Knowledge, Rules, People, Repositories, Secrets, Sessions, Profile, Guard, Versions, Health, Help
- [The panel from another device](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/panel-remote.md): augmented-brain panel remote, through your own Tailscale network; who can open it; always temporary
- [Configuration versions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/config-history.md): the last 10 versions of the configuration; what changed; going back from the panel or with config history and config restore
- [The weekly review](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/weekly-review.md): what it goes through, when it is offered, with Claude or in the panel
- [Backup and restore](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/backup.md): a private git repository per space, automatic after each session; a new machine; what a restore does not bring
- [Connect your services](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/connect-services.md): calendar, mail, documents and Jira through MCP
- [Remote access](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/remote.md): augmented-brain remote: Claude on this computer reachable from anywhere, also after a reboot (Linux); a session per task with session start
- [Bring in a memory you already have](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/import.md): augmented-brain import: plan first, --apply, --map, --repos-base
- [From your phone or another computer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/anywhere.md): remote access and the panel together, which session to use, what to do when it stops answering
- [Updating and uninstalling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/update-and-uninstall.md): what update does, the three levels of uninstall, moving to a new computer
- [Commands](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/commands.md): every command and flag, including mcp, hook and its events, version and help
- [MCP tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/mcp-tools.md): every MCP tool, grouped by purpose, with every parameter
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/configuration.md): every config.toml setting with an example; secrets.toml; other files; environment variables
- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/guide/troubleshooting.md): problems and fixes, doctor, the panel's Help page; common questions
- [Memory format](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/docs/spec/memory-format.md): folders, note headers, configuration, backup; the contract
- [Full documentation in one file](https://icalvete.github.io/augmented-brain/llms-full.txt): every English page above, concatenated as Markdown
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icalvete/augmented-brain/main/README.md): what it is, install in two steps, commands
